signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Ownership: You set direction, make hard tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, not just features.
Discovery: You stay close to customers, frame the right problems, and validate solutions with fast feedback loops.
Data & rigor: You define success metrics, use evidence to prioritize, and keep iterating.
Cross-functional leadership: You work across engineering and GTM to keep teams aligned and execution unblocked.
Communication: You write and think clearly. Crisp docs, clear decisions, and straightforward tradeoffs.
